title: The Ledger of Fallen Stars
story: In the crater meadow where starfall lands, Drimswallow the Meteor Ledger hoards every shard that drops and has locked away the village's wishing-shard. It will open its stone ledger only if five shards on the scale average exactly 46 glims of brightness — no more, no less. Mr 6 has four shards already glowing, and one plain shard he may polish to any brightness he likes.
question: The four shards measure 38, 52, 41, and 45 glims. How many glims must the fifth shard be polished to so that all five average exactly 46 glims?
solution: Five shards averaging 46 must total 46 x 5 = 230 glims.
The four shards he has add up to 38 + 52 + 41 + 45 = 176 glims.
So the last shard needs 230 - 176 = 54 glims.
praise: Thinking about the average was the right path — the trick is that an average hides a TOTAL inside it, and the total had to be found before subtracting.
hint: Work backwards: if five shards average 46, what must all five add up to together?
victory: Mr 6 buffed the pale shard until it hummed at 54 glims, and the ledger creaked open in surprise. Drimswallow handed over the wishing-shard, muttering that no one had ever audited it back before.
imagePrompt: A small knightly numeral six polishes a glowing meteor fragment on a brass scale in a night-blue crater meadow, while a long-necked ledger-keeping creature made of ash and starlight peers over a stone book.
